category.zh: 分子表示 · 可解释建模

summary.zh: 从分子结构与表面性质出发，构建化学可解释的描述符，连接特征筛选、预测建模与模型解释。
summary.en: A workflow connecting molecular structures and surface properties with chemically interpretable descriptors, feature selection, predictive modeling and model interpretation.

category.zh: 文献调研 · 知识整理

summary.zh: 围绕科学问题，将网页阅读、大语言模型分析、引用扩展与本地文献整理连接起来。
summary.en: A local literature research tool connecting page reading, LLM analysis, citation expansion and local research records.

name: pKa-ML Education

category.zh: 化学教育 · 无代码机器学习

summary.zh: 以有机酸 pKa 预测为例，用图形界面和五组渐进数据集教授特征工程与决策树。
summary.en: A graphical decision-tree tool and five teaching datasets introducing feature engineering through organic acid pKa prediction.

name_zh: pKa 机器学习教学工具

category.zh: 双光子吸收 · 计算工作流

summary.zh: 连接 Gaussian 激发态计算、Multiwfn 跃迁偶极矩提取和 MATLAB 双光子吸收批量分析。
summary.en: A Gaussian–Multiwfn–MATLAB workflow for excited-state calculations, transition dipole extraction and batch TPA analysis.

category.zh: 量子化学 · 描述符提取

summary.zh: 批量处理 Gaussian 格式化检查点文件，调用 Multiwfn 提取分子描述符并整理为 CSV。
summary.en: A helper for extracting Multiwfn molecular descriptors from Gaussian formatted checkpoint files into a CSV feature matrix.

category.zh: 楼栋风压暴露 · 巡检规划

summary.en: A local desktop prototype that connects building annotation, wind-direction scenarios and facade/floor-band visualizations for exploratory inspection planning.
summary.zh: 连接楼栋标注、风向情景和立面／楼层段可视化的本地桌面原型，服务于探索性的巡检规划。

availability.en: Desktop demonstration available by enquiry. Public source and software package release are pending.
availability.zh: 可联系了解桌面演示；公开源码和软件安装包尚待整理发布。

alt.en: Four-step schematic: annotate buildings, set wind scenarios, compare facade and floor-band exposure, and review exports.
alt.zh: 四步工作流示意：标注楼栋、设置风向情景、比较立面与楼层段暴露、查看并导出结果。

caption.en: Workflow schematic. Geometry is illustrative, not a map or a computed result.
caption.zh: 工作流示意图。图中几何为示意，不是真实底图或计算结果。

alt.en: Original desktop export showing a pseudo-3D building and floor-band pressure estimates as wind direction changes; the prototype interface is in Chinese.
alt.zh: 桌面软件已有导出：伪三维楼栋及不同风向下的楼层段风压估计。

caption.en: Original desktop export (Chinese interface). Values illustrate the simplified screening model; they are not validated design loads or measured damage probabilities.
caption.zh: 桌面软件原始导出。数值展示简化筛查模型的输出，不是经验证的设计荷载或实测破坏概率。
